mechanism: NSAIDs can reduce the renal clearance of beta-lactam antibiotics and potentially decrease ampicillin efficacy while increasing ampicillin levels, and diclofenac may increase ampicillin-related GI irritation.
action: Monitor renal function and ampicillin efficacy; consider alternative NSAID or antibiotic if renal impairment present; use lowest effective NSAID dose and shortest duration.
